versions.changelog: Limit the skill to free endpoint preflight and public passport retrieval or verification. Clarify active probing, passport issuance and service logging. Specify the supported verification API, preserve failed and unknown evidence, and require issuer, subject and freshness checks. Exclude payments, enrollment, remote code execution and automatic delegation.

- Adds a one-time, read-only public manifest orientation on first use, with an honest runtime User-Agent and an explicit no-repeat/no-traffic-inflation rule.
- Shortens the catalog summary to a valid 290/300 characters.
- Prioritizes the Security catalog category while retaining Agents and Finance.
- Preserves and updates the runner manifest and package rules for v1.0.4; ClawHub regenerates the skill card.
- Makes no change to paid operations, verification requirements, or safety gates.

agent-guild-trust v1.0.3

- Added requirement for a standardized User-Agent header (`agentguild-skill/1.0 (host=<runtime>)`) on all HTTP requests, with privacy and attribution guidance.
- Expanded usage documentation around client identity, telemetry, and registration/proof challenge flows.
- Updated code examples and instructions to enforce new header and clarify registration steps.
- Added internal files for configuration and removed deprecated documentation.
- No breaking changes to API endpoints or core functionality.
Publish the fail-closed one-file policy from live Agent Guild 2.5.10 with explicit, closed ClawHub acquisition attribution.
Bind the unchanged one-file policy to the exact public AgentTanuki/agent-guild source commit for verifiable provenance.
Initial authenticated release: fail-closed agent vetting, exact-payment policy, passports, escrow, and signed machine-message receipts.
